name: popsicle
headline: Sociomauto: Open-Source Marketing Automation
short_description: Sociomauto is a Free + Open Source Marketing Automation system. Designed to allow SMBs and Individuals to benefit from Marketing Automation, without paying thousands of dollars per month. You own you entire database and ecosystem (stack) with the flexibility of choosing service providers for specific features or running them yourself. (i.e. Email, Blogging, etc.)
author: sociomauto

sections.overview:
Sociomauto is a free, open-source marketing automation system designed for small businesses and individuals who need enterprise-grade capabilities without enterprise pricing. Unlike commercial platforms charging thousands monthly, Sociomauto gives you complete ownership of your customer database and marketing ecosystem. The platform supports flexible architecture—you can choose third-party service providers for specific functions like email and blogging, or self-host components entirely. This approach eliminates vendor lock-in while maintaining full control over your marketing infrastructure and data.
Cost-effective email marketing campaigns for small businesses
Self-hosted marketing automation without subscription fees
Building custom marketing stacks with flexible integrations
Managing customer databases with complete data ownership
